name: orbit-calibrated-live-v2
notes: ONE change vs the champion: fit a strictly monotone Platt map from raw scores to probabilities on the live validation split, then choose the threshold on calibrated validation scores (no test row is seen). Pre-registered before split v2 existed because host-grouped CV showed most of the F1 loss comes from transferring a threshold chosen on ~45 rows. Same features, same hyperparameters, same seed.
